name: ReflectWorld
description: Visual perception + persistent memory platform for AI agents

cam.description: Cam plugin config (video capture). See @reflectworld/cam for fields.

vlm_model.description: Primary VLM model for multi-frame analysis

vlm_model_lite.description: Smaller/cheaper VLM model for snapshot or single-frame analysis

vlm_api_key.description: API key for the selected VLM provider

llm_model.description: Text-only model for compression and narrative summaries

vlm_request_timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout for VLM/LLM calls in milliseconds

vlm_max_retries.description: Max retry count after first VLM attempt

vlm_retry_base_delay_ms.description: Base backoff delay for VLM retries in milliseconds

vlm_retry_max_delay_ms.description: Max backoff delay for VLM retries in milliseconds

scene_description.description: Describes the camera's scene for VLM context

focus_targets.description: Targets to pay extra attention to

working_memory_event_timeout_sec.description: Seconds of inactivity before an open event is closed

working_memory_max_event_segments.description: Maximum segments allowed before an open event is force-rotated

stubs_only.description: When true, local detection/ReID analyzers remain as stubs

required_level.description: Minimum required perception level. 0 keeps local models optional; 1+ makes missing local capability fatal.

stt_provider.description: STT provider: moonshine, elevenlabs, or empty string to disable

stt_model_dir.description: Path to Moonshine Tiny model directory

stt_num_threads.description: Number of CPU threads for STT inference

memory.description: Memory service/client config plus Python mem model credentials.

storage_path.description: Isolated storage path for Python mem artifacts

collection_name.description: Base Qdrant collection prefix exposed as pluginConfig memory.collection_name

baseUrl.description: ReflectWorld API base URL for the memory client

timeoutMs.description: Memory client HTTP request timeout in milliseconds

user_id.description: All-in-one alias for default memory user_id

defaultCameraId.description: Default camera_id for memory tool requests

defaultUserId.description: Default user_id for memory tool requests

defaultSearchMemoryType.description: Default memory type for search operations

defaultSearchLimit.description: Default result limit for search operations

embedder_provider.description: Python mem embedder provider; use openai with embedder_base_url for OpenAI-compatible services

embedder_base_url.description: Python mem embedder OpenAI-compatible base URL

embedding_dims.description: Embedding vector dimensions for Python mem collections

llm_api_key.description: Python mem text LLM API key

llm_base_url.description: Python mem text LLM OpenAI-compatible base URL
